name: SideNav
label: Side nav
description: Vertical navigation links for drawers and long sidebars: sections, three indent levels, expand toggles, a compact size and its own scroll.

props.name: items
props.description: Navigation tree to render: rows, and at the top level, sections of rows.

props.name: size
props.description:
Row density. `default` sets every row on the default control height; `compact` sets
every row on the 32px compact control height, for a long sidebar of
pages (a documentation site's hundred entries).

props.name: scrollable
props.description:
Make the list its own scroll area: it fills the height its parent
gives it, scrolls inside without carrying the page along at its ends,
and brings the current row into view when it first renders. Put it in
a column with a fixed or sticky height.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: href of the current page — the exactly matching row gets `aria-current="page"` and the active treatment.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Controlled list of expanded item ids.

props.name: defaultExpandedIds
props.description:
Initially expanded item ids (uncontrolled). The branch and the
collapsible section that hold the current page start open as well, so a
reader landing deep in a long tree sees where they are.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the full new list of expanded ids whenever a toggle is pressed, in both controlled and uncontrolled modes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several branches expanded at once. Default false: expanding one collapses its siblings, never the section or the rows it sits in.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Fires when any link is clicked, alongside native navigation — e.g. to close the drawer that contains the list.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a collapsed row's or section's toggle, given its label. Defaults to "Expand <label>".

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of an expanded row's or section's toggle, given its label. Defaults to "Collapse <label>".

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; passed on to each row's Button. Wins over a
LinkProvider's; a plain `<a>` when neither is set.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

SideNavEntry.description: A top-level entry: a row, or a section of rows.

SideNavSection.description:
A titled section of rows: a heading over its items, the way a long
documentation sidebar groups its pages. Sections sit only at the top
level; their items nest like any others.

rows.text: Opens what it controls, and closes it when it is open.

alternatives.name: DrillMenu
alternatives.when: the menu fills a phone screen and each branch should open as a level of its own
